operatorApproval.notes: Worker pane t06 (pane w8:pE, metabolomics/qwen3.8-flash_next) on base 75a15f0b; src/aps/index.ts already re-exports types.ts so only the two declared files changed. AgentAction carries optional taskProvenance ({state:'known';authority;taskId} | {state:'unknown';reason}) and modelProvenance ({provider;model;quantization}), inherited by AgentLoopCandidateEvent/AgentLoopPreventedEvent, plus exported pure helpers describeTaskProvenance (known only for ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ with a non-empty trimmed task id; reasons distinguish missing from malformed, and non-string input says 'not a string'), describeModelProvenance (quantization via the same /[-_]quant[-_]([a-z0-9._]+)/i convention as PiWorkerExecutor.ts:2545) and isKnownTaskProvenance. Repo-wide typecheck passes with no caller touched, proving the additive fields keep every existing event literal valid; producers are deliberately unwired. Conductor probe (logs/03) verified all nine task-provenance shapes, six model-id shapes (int8/4bit/fp16 extracted, plain ids null, non-string parts null, ids trimmed) and a legacy action literal with only the pre-existing fields. Known gap: describeTaskProvenance/describeModelProvenance dereference `input` without a default, so an untyped JS caller passing undefined throws (a typed caller cannot); the producer-wiring unit should add `= {}` within its own budget.
